title: すっきり牌合わせ ～PAIR TILE～
tagline: 同じ柄を、ひと組ずつ。時間を気にせず、盤面すっきり。
genre: relaxed layered tile matching / mahjong solitaire

controls.summary: クリック / タップ / キーボードで同柄の空いた牌を2枚選ぶ。任意のヒント・戻す・並べ替え
controls.evidence: src/games/game020/main.ts and game.manifest.json; final actual UI controls are authoritative

expectedRunSecondsBasis: self-paced without a time limit; human duration not measured

difficulty.label: 標準
difficulty.basis: design assessment; mobile legibility prioritizes two compact board sizes; human feedback pending

mainMechanics: Remove two identical original geometric-icon tiles when both have no tile above and at least one open left or right side; clear the layered board at your own pace
description: 上が塞がれず左右どちらかが空いた同柄2枚を取り、重なる盤面を落ち着いて片付ける
failureModes: 無効選択はペナルティなし。詰まりは戻す・解法検証済みの並べ替えで継続可能。時間切れ・ミス終了なし

design.thumbnailDescription: 実プレイ盤面のオリジナル幾何学アイコン牌、軽い影と明確な重なり
design.majorVisuals: 独自の輪・三角・星など形と模様で区別する牌。色だけに依存しない
design.directionNotes: Quiet original code-drawn geometric icons; no character, copied tile art, or copied map
design.referenceImageUse: No third-party visual assets or user character references used
design.uiPolicy: Responsive accessible selection; optional explanation and isolated practice; no timer or urgency

telemetryCoverage: Existing common events plus event tile_pair/hint/undo/reshuffle; no per-frame logs or practice BEST/production run data. External delivery depends on existing configuration and deployed Worker registration
humanEvaluation: pending; author unplayed publication explicitly authorized; AI operation/image checks are not subjective human review

currentManifest.title: すっきり牌合わせ ～PAIR TILE～
currentManifest.tagline: 同じ柄を、ひと組ずつ。時間を気にせず、盤面すっきり。
currentManifest.genre: relaxed layered tile matching / mahjong solitaire
currentManifest.coreMechanic: Remove two identical original geometric-icon tiles when both have no tile above and at least one open left or right side; clear the layered board at your own pace

inputs.select: click / tap a tile; keyboard focus and Enter / Space select
inputs.assist: optional hint, undo one pair, solvable reshuffle, restart or next board

boards.construction: original compact layouts; reverse removal assignment retains a verified solution
boards.stuck: no game over; undo or solution-verified reshuffle of remaining tiles

currentManifest.practice: Optional isolated pair-selection lesson; no production run events, BEST, saved board or cleared-board statistics
currentManifest.bestStorage: bestPairs: maximum pairs removed on one board; clearedBoards: completed boards; separate new020 keys only
currentManifest.jev: development-only Shadow Review on observed findings; no runtime API or automatic gate
currentManifest.humanReview: author subjective playtest and physical-device review pending; user explicitly authorized publication before author play
currentManifest.telemetry: Existing common events and specific_game_events with event tile_pair/hint/undo/reshuffle; event-level only; practice isolated; upload requires existing consent/environment/endpoint
